fields.summary_ko.0: As SK Hynix forecasts continued memory shortages through 2030, Lam Research (LRCX) rose +5%, Applied Materials (AMAT) +4%, and KLA (KLAC) +3%, with semiconductor equipment makers extending a three-day winning streak.
fields.summary_ko.1: Lam Research is guiding December quarter revenue to $8.6 billion (±$400 million), with supply chain constraints and China exposure to determine the sustainability of the rally.
